digest.component_or_area: test suite reliability oracles (subprocess and network timeouts)
propositions: Two test-only real-time windows (10s low-speed for snapshot, 1s per-attempt for ACLI) contribute multi-second wall time per test without reflecting the actual contract (throughput, retry schedule, process count, cleanup).
Snapshot stall test must use real loopback socket, serve bytes above configured floor for more than one complete injected window, and not be classified as a stall.

ACLI read-retry test must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real child processes, observe exact production retry schedule [2, 4] without sleeping, and confirm all spawned PIDs are absent after terminal failure.
Production defaults for timeout, stall window, grace, drain, attempt count, and backoff values must remain unchanged in code or constants.
Test execution time must reduce to single-digit seconds without adding wall-clock pass assertions, brittle deadlines, skips, xfails, or changes to production code paths.
